comparison.objective: Separate the halves of a side-release strap buckle.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneously compress two opposed tabs while applying axial separation force.
comparison.success_condition: Both tabs are depressed sufficiently and the tongue is pulled fully clear without either half falling off the table.
comparison.reason: PR-2163 tests coordinated latch release under opposing forces. The candidate has no latch and instead evaluates loose-body passage through apertures, selective retention, and screen reseating.
